title: Pinned tensor counit restriction on homotopy complexes
statement: For an arbitrary homotopy complex P on X and a commuting open square, the constructed restricted coefficient for the identity of Lk*(Qh P), followed by restriction of the pinned left-derived counit for k, the exact restriction factorization and the localized homotopy tensor restriction comparison, equals Lj* of the exact restriction factorization at P followed by the pinned counit for j at the restricted homotopy complex. This is before any mapped-single comparison or direct image. Definitions and ingredients: [def-pc-open-pinned-single-tensor-restriction-iso], [def-pc-single-complex-open-restriction-data], [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition].

proof.text: Expand singleComplexRestrictedCoefficient and remove the restricted identity map. Apply the target-open triangle, cancel the inverse derived composition comparison, use the termwise tensor comparison and counit transport identity across hj, then apply the source-open triangle. This is an equality of composites for arbitrary P and adds no flatness or other hypotheses.
